#Visualize data

Plotting the spatial coordinates and with the annotation
```{r}
plotCoords(speBreast, point_size = 5)
plotCoords(speBreast, point_size = 5, annotate = 'annotation')
```
Highliting one specific spot
```{r}
x_all <- spatialCoords(speBreast)[, colnames(coordinates)[1]]
y_all <- spatialCoords(speBreast)[, colnames(coordinates)[2]]

# 1. Find all spots belonging to the topmost row (minimum Y)
top_row <- y_all == min(y_all)

# 2. Pick the leftmost spot (minimum X) among those in the top row
target_idx <- which(top_row)[which.min(x_all[top_row])]

# 3. Create the logical mask (TRUE only for that single top-left spot)
mask <- seq_along(x_all) == target_idx

# 4. Add metadata and plot
colData(speBreast)$top_left <- factor(mask, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("Other", "Target"))

plotCoords(speBreast, annotate = "top_left", point_size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other" = "black", "Target" = "red"))
```
